text.description_html:
Stainless Steel Finish Commercial Door Kit w/ Frame and Hardware Kit, GLO-KS3068BRAJ901

The Global Door Controls Hollow Metal Door Kit is engineered for high-performance commercial entryways. It features a Steelcraft 3-hour fire-rated 18-gauge steel door with a polystyrene core and a fully adjustable 16-gauge steel frame for seamless installation. Included Panic Hardware Kit includes a Grade 1 UL-listed heavy duty rim exit device with exterior escutcheon keyed entry lever, ADA-compliant adjustable door closer, and three heavy-duty steel hinges with non removable pin for security. Designed for safety, durability, and code compliance in high-traffic environments. Choose from two sizes, 3' 0" x 6' 8" or 3' 0" x 7' 0".

Listed by UL / ULC for ratings of "A" Label (3 hours), UL10C approved, Grade 1 certified panic hardware and door closer, ADA Compliant

Features and Specifications Pre-Hung Commercial Metal Door with Hardware, GLO-KS3068BRAJ901

  • Door Sizes: 3' 0" x 6' 8" or 3' 0" x 7' 0"
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/4"
  • Door Material: 18 gauge galvanized steel, polystyrene filled
  • Door Finish: Stainless Steel
  • Fire Resistant: 3 Hour Fire Label
  • Hinges: 4-1/2" x 4-1/2" steel with non-removable pin for security
  • Frame: Adjustable 18 gauge steel
  • Header: 36" Adjustable 16 gauge steel
  • Hinge Jamb: 80" Adjustable 16 gauge steel
  • Strike Jamb: 80" Adjustable 16 gauge steel
  • Handing: Doors are handed
  • Manufacturer's Warranty: 1 Year Limited
